text: Independent review of the in-progress support index: volume_stencil is a genuine linear fix (97k voxels in 2.35s, 24 us/voxel). coordinate_cells is NOT - it keeps an O(p x n_groups) term from character-keyed groups[candidate_keys] in .coordinate_ball_members (R/support-index.R:195-228). Measured 287 us/voxel at p=50653, only ~1.5x faster than the all-pairs loop at p=8000. Lookup alone is 73% of runtime at radius 1.1. The 50k acceptance test at test-support-index.R:125 uses volume_domain and asserts a STORAGE bound only, so this is not currently gated. Details and fix in bd-01KZXBT2GF4E4W9N685KAHAYER.
